title: Independent common-community confirmation of reproductive payoff rank reversals after contrasting pollinator histories
relation_to_previous: The 4-history ×2-repeat exploratory island-history 512-case post-transfer campaign motivated, but does not count toward, this separate independent-histories confirmation. The frozen four-setting generality campaign in PR411 is unchanged.
post_switch_readout: first reproductive period with exactly identical new visitor community in near- and far-history populations
inference_unit: independent visitor history, never individual demographic repeat or arm
readouts: t400 resident size and trait means/variances
post-switch immediate viable maternal seed output per resident plant
immediate female outcross seed output per resident plant
immediate pollen export per resident plant
same-visitor fixed-state 2x2 clamped investment and assurance mean factorial, explanatory only
paired_contrasts: far-history minus near-history, matched by setting × mode × visitor-history × demographic-repeat, followed by averaging the two nested repeats within visitor-history
frozen_primary_joint_rule: prior_selfing + evolving: viable_maternal far-minus-near mean >0 and bootstrap95 lower >0
pollen_discount + evolving: viable_maternal far-minus-near mean >0 and bootstrap95 lower >0
assurance_cost + evolving: viable_maternal far-minus-near mean <0 and bootstrap95 upper <0
prior_selfing + evolving: female_outcross far-minus-near mean <0 and bootstrap95 upper <0
pollen_discount + evolving: female_outcross far-minus-near mean <0 and bootstrap95 upper <0
all_other_settings_and_modes: always report all metrics, including failures, mixed signs, convergence to zero, and counterexamples
factorial_scope: post-hoc source of hypothesis; I/A mean-level clamping is a new fixed-state perturbation, not a mediation fraction. Factorial outcomes remain explanatory regardless of primary gate.
safeguards: never relabel success without all five preregistered sign-and-interval rules
no parameter changes or expanded histories after reading outcomes
no ecological rescue claim when all 48 capacity populations remain occupied
initial near and far histories share genetically identical founders; post-switch visitor community for each pair is identical
no colonist-arrival filter or model-based natural-island calibration
fixed assay retains realized selfing at constant assurance capacity
selection gradients must use corrected rare-mutant fixed-resident formula, not whole-population derivative
all case receipts and source hashes required for confirmatory label
